note: Weekly community bulletin — the Broadcast reads from this feed. Items are stitched from engagement data: PBs, birthdays, race deadlines, new joiners, gossip. The pipeline that writes this weekly comes later; today it's seeded.

items.text: Three PBs at Saturday's sim — Maya finally cracked the sled and Rio owned the wall balls.
Two new faces joined Tuesday's class — say hi if you spot them.
Maya turns thirty this week — cake after Tuesday's class is not optional.
Jakarta race entries close Friday — if your name's not on the list yet, that one's on you now.
Four of the crew are eyeing the same race weekend — the travel board's waiting, pair up before flights go up.
And Katie — happy birthday for Tuesday. Your 7am session's in the book; I'll bring the coffee and croissants on the way in.

followUp.text: The pic: me and Katie, coffee and croissants after the 7am. I keep my promises.
